items.title: Wallace Davenport Interview, 1995-11-14
items.q: he left Woody Harman, I know he left Woody Harman band to come with us.

ctx.x: That's right. And your meals? And your meals?

That's right. The only thing we didn't have to pay was, but see, Buddy Richen, that's a guy, a little white dude named Don Rader, he was good, good trumpet player. He left Woody Harman, I know he left Woody Harman band to come with us. And he said, man, shit, I wish I had known that Basie was paying this kind of money. I would have been over here, man. He said, we didn't get, we were getting thirteen or fourteen dollars a night with Buddy Rich. And another guy who left staying kitten bands, a white guy, he came…
What about, okay, so you had transportation they paid for, but you had meals, hotel, what about your laundry? I mean you had a suit every night, right? No, not the uniform.
